applicableDomain: Diagnostic Radiology & DICOM Modality Imaging Fulfillment
descriptionAndPurpose: Independently executable child subworkflow routing signed imaging orders into radiology modality queues, applying service-level billing clearance, managing DICOM study acquisition and radiologist report signing, and routing final or critical imaging reports back to the ordering clinician.
prerequisiteConditions: Signed imaging order with clinical indication and modality specified.
Replay-safe idempotency verified prior to creating radiology worklist entry.
safetyChecks: Pregnancy, contrast allergy, and eGFR renal safety screening prior to contrast or ionizing radiation.
Critical incidental or acute findings (e.g., pneumothorax, intracranial hemorrhage) immediately trigger CLINICIAN_CRITICAL_RESULT_ESCALATION.
financialAndAuthorizationPolicies: Service-level IMAGING clearance evaluated via WorkflowBillingClearancePolicySpi.
Trauma/emergency imaging bypasses prepayment via EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE.
cancellationAndResumptionRules: Unperformed studies may be placed ON_HOLD for patient preparation (e.g., fasting/renal hydration) and resumed on the same orderId without re-billing.
auditAndProvenanceRequirements: Audit trail captures technologist ID, radiation dose / contrast lot where applicable, DICOM StudyInstanceUID, and signing radiologist credentials.
completionCriteria: Radiologist-signed diagnostic report durably delivered to responsible clinician inbox.
